objectives: Listens to nursery rhymes or poem read by the teacher and responds with appropriate sounds, words, and motions. Follows verbal directions. Describes pictures in oral sentences. Compares and contrasts characteristics/attributes of people and/or things.
Rhymes word patterns in poems. Produces words with same beginning sounds. Matches same initial word sounds with written word symbols. Recognizes and names upper and lower case alphabet letters.
Models and draws lines demonstrating the concept of “top to bottom” and “left to right”. Models and forms lower and upper case letters of the alphabet. Copies simple words.
Uses simple vocabulary and short phrases in Spanish.
